description: This file defines the MulBinary class, which represents a multiplication binary operation node within the Twig template engine's abstract syntax tree. It extends AbstractBinary and implements the operator method to output the multiplication operator.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\Binary\MulBinary
classes.description: Represents a multiplication operation node in Twig's expression AST, providing the operator symbol '*' when compiling.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the raw '*' operator to be used in compiled PHP code for this binary multiplication node.
